spec.description:
Autex Composition Velour Panel is an acoustic wall panel featuring a plush
fine-velour Vertiface finish that provides superior acoustic absorption and a
soft tactile surface. Available as pre-cut panels and Peel 'n' Stick acoustic
tiles (600mm x 600mm), it transforms blank walls into decorative, pinnable, and
hook-and-loop receptive acoustic features. Made from 100% polyester fibre with
recycled content, it achieves an NRC of 0.40 and Group 1 fire rating, delivering
noise control and functionality for educational and commercial interiors.

install:
Ensure substrate
is clean, dust-free, dry, and sealed if bare plasterboard

Acclimatise tiles
or panels in the room for at least 24 hours

Mark a level baseline and
vertical plumb line on the wall

Check arrow on backing release paper to
maintain uniform pile direction or alternate for quarter-turn pattern

Peel
back release film from self-adhesive backing

Position tile firmly against
guideline and press into place

Roll firmly across the entire tile surface
with a pressure roller to activate pressure-sensitive adhesive

Trim perimeter
tiles using a straight edge and sharp utility knife
selection_checklist: Confirm fine velour finish texture preference

Select colour from Autex
Vertiface palette

Choose laying pattern (all arrows pointing in same
direction vs alternating quarter-turn check)

Calculate required square
meterage (each 6-pack covers 2.16 m²)

Confirm substrate is primed and free of
peeling paint or grease
accessories:
Autex
Edging Solutions Type A aluminium trims

Utility knife and metal straight
edge
limitations:
Pressure-sensitive adhesive requires firm rolling for
permanent adhesion

Indoor use only; not suitable for high-humidity or wet
areas
Do not apply over unprimed, powdery, or flaking surfaces

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Composition Velour Panel is
a 10-12mm thick acoustic wall panel featuring a plush fine-velour Vertiface
finish, available in modular 600mm x 600mm Peel 'n' Stick tiles and large
panels. Engineered from 100% polyester fibre with recycled content, it provides
an NRC of 0.40, excellent thermal resistance (R0.22), and an exceptionally
durable hook-and-loop and pin-receptive surface. Group 1 fire-rated and
carbon-neutral certified, it offers an easy, mess-free peel-and-stick
installation that reduces chatter and creates functional pinboard surfaces in
offices, schools, and homes.
